narrative.overview:
The system makes a campus meal decision feel like an edited recommendation, not a directory wall. A bone-white canvas gives one oversized question room to breathe, while matte-black fields and full-bleed food photography make the few chosen options feel immediate and specific. The visual voice is minimalist, clean, culinary, and decisive; it rejects the generic SaaS hero and the endless marketplace feed.

Oversized rounded controls translate the supplied culinary-exploration reference into responsive web form. Manrope Variable keeps the expression neutral and contemporary, acid lime marks the next or current action, and soft translucent surfaces appear only where sticky context or imagery needs legible controls. The result is quiet around the decision and cinematic around the food.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant decision headline and one clear path forward.
Bone-white quiet space paired with matte-black editorial fields.
Acid lime reserved for active, focused, or forward-moving moments.
Full-bleed, high-contrast culinary photography with deliberate crops.
Oversized pills, circles, and softly clipped media surfaces.
Glass used precisely for legibility over media and sticky context.

rules.name: The One Lime Rule
rules.body: Acid lime identifies a current selection, visible focus, or the next action; it never becomes a broad background wash. The darker wordmark dot is the only identity-only variation.

rules.name: The Culinary Black Rule
rules.body: Matte black belongs to decisive controls and editorial food fields, not to generic full-page dark mode.

rules.name: The Decision Is the Display Rule
rules.body: Use the largest type for a choice the user can act on, not for a brand slogan or decorative metric.

rules.name: The Tight-Not-Cramped Rule
rules.body: Large headlines use tight line-height and tracking, while supporting copy returns to open 1.5–1.6 line-height for easy scanning.

rules.name: The Edited Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Give the question and imagery generous room, then keep the available choices short, close, and immediately actionable.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Do not lift ordinary surfaces with drop shadows; separate them with tone, crop, border, or spacing.

rules.name: The Earned Glass Rule
rules.body: Blur is for legibility over photography or continuity in sticky chrome. Opaque content panels stay opaque.

rules.name: The Silhouette Carries the System Rule
rules.body: Reuse the same pill, circle, medium-card, and large-surface families; do not introduce isolated corner styles.

dos: Do build the first viewport around one oversized decision question, one search field, and one cinematic food image.
Do use glossy, high-contrast, full-bleed culinary photography with a crop chosen for its slot.
Do keep Acid Lime rare and state-bearing: active, focused, selected, or forward.
Do use Matte Ink to frame a deliberately short, trusted set of choices.
Do collapse the triptych and preserve the action hierarchy at the 1100px, 850px, and 620px breakpoints.
donts: Don't turn the experience into an endless directory wall or a dense marketplace feed.
Don't replace the culinary image field with a generic SaaS gradient, abstract illustration, or metric dashboard.
Don't introduce multiple bright accents or large Acid Lime background fields.
Don't place decorative glass across ordinary content; reserve it for sticky context and media legibility.
Don't add new radius values when a pill, circle, 1.2rem panel, 1.65rem card, or 2.25rem surface already fits.
